[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "dangerous < danger (Middle English, from Old French dangier / dangierous, ultimately from Vulgar Latin *dominiarium, \"power, dominion\") + woman (Old English wīfmann, \"female person\")",
    "reading": "A woman under power: not merely perilous, but one who stands in dominion, constraint, or command.",
    "languages": ["en", "fro", "la", "ang"],
    "source": "OED; TLFi; Oxford Dictionary of English Etymology",
    "confidence": 0.86
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "dangerous woman = danger + us + wo + man; danger / us / wo / man",
    "reading": "The peril is shared: danger is ours; the woman is split into wound and man, a divided human figure.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.62
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "dangerous ~ danger + ous; ous sounds like Fr. ous / où? and woman ~ Fr. femme? no, instead wo-man as \"woe-man\"",
    "reading": "A woman of woe: the sound of woman opens into lament, sorrow, and the cry of danger.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.55
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "dangerous = dang-er-ous; dang ~ ding / don / donjon; er = air; ous = us",
    "reading": "A towered warning: the word rises like a fortress of air, enclosing us in a ringing alarm.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.41
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "DANGEROUS WOMAN -> A WANDEROUS MONG?; partial anagram: woman + danger = wand + omen + us",
    "reading": "A wandering omen: the letters suggest a moving sign, a female figure carrying warning within her.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.33
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "D A N G E R O U S W O M A N = Doomed, Alert, Night-born, Guarded, Enigmatic, Radiant, Omen-bearing, Unbound, Secret, Wombed, Open, Mortal, Ancient, Numinous",
    "reading": "An acrostic of peril and power: a woman marked by omen, secrecy, and unbound force.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.28
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "D-A-N-G-E-R-O-U-S / W-O-M-A-N: D as door, O as circle, W as double wave, M as mountain, N as crossing",
    "reading": "A threshold crossed by waves and mountains: the letters depict a mutable feminine force entering danger.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.24
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "dangerous woman = 9 + 7 letters; 9 as completion, 7 as ordeal; woman = 5 letters, danger = 8 letters",
    "reading": "Completion meets ordeal: the phrase balances wholeness against trial, suggesting initiation through risk.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.19
  }
]
